DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その広報をお持ち帰りになりたいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to take that public information bulletin home, is that right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場で同僚に見せたいです。掲示板に一部だけあるので、外して持っていってよいか先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 掲示一部を職場用に外せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to show it to my colleagues at work. There is only one copy on the noticeboard, so I want to ask first whether I may take it down and take it with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may remove the single posted copy for your workplace. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 掲示している原本は、そのまま残してください。配布用があるか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please leave the original posted copy where it is. I will check whether we have copies for distribution.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ外していません。自分の同僚に便利でも、後から来る人が読めなくなるのは困りますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未撤去と他来訪者の閲覧を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't taken it down yet. Even if it would be useful to my colleagues, it would be a problem if people arriving later could no longer read it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not removed it and are considering other visitors' ability to read it. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この内容は、配布用の紙を一部お渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can give you one paper copy of this information for distribution.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一部で大丈夫です。職場の休憩室へ置き、必要な人が見る形にします。掲示原本を持ち帰る予定はやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 配布紙一部で職場閲覧にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: One copy is fine. I'll put it in the break room at work so that anyone who needs it can read it. I'll give up my plan to take the posted original home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will use one distribution copy for people to read at work. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 発行日が分かる部分も、残しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also keep the part showing the publication date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 日付は切り取らず残します。問い合わせる同僚には、古い案内になることもあるので最新の受付情報を確認するよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発行日維持と最新受付確認を同僚へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll leave the date intact without cutting it off. I'll tell colleagues who want to inquire to check the latest reception information, since the notice may become out of date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell your colleagues that you will retain the publication date and that they should check the latest reception information. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お渡しする一部は、こちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is the copy for you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受け取りました。貼ってある物ではなく配布用だと分かったので、こちらを職場へ持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 配布用受領で掲示原本を残して帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received it. Now that I know this is a distribution copy rather than the posted item, I'll take this one to work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Receive the distribution copy and leave with the posted original still in place. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお役立てください。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I hope you find it useful. Take care on your way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察の後に、確認したいことはございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you would like to check after your consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族へ説明を送りたいのですが、メモが短すぎます。「来週」とだけ書いたので、検査なのか電話なのか覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 来週だけの本人メモの用件が不明と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to send my family an explanation, but my notes are too brief. I only wrote 'next week,' so I don't remember whether it meant a test or a phone call.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you do not know what the 'next week' entry in your own notes refers to. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのメモだけで、ご家族へ検査予定とお伝えにならないでください。担当へ確認を頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please don't tell your family that a test is scheduled based on that note alone. I'll ask the person in charge to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ送っていません。分からない部分だけ先に確かめ、覚えている症状の話まで作り直すつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未送信で不明予定箇所だけ確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't sent it yet. I want to check just the unclear part first; I don't intend to rewrite even the discussion of symptoms that I do remember.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not sent it and only want to confirm the unclear part of the schedule. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お手元に、診察で渡された案内もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you also have the information sheet you were given during the consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。予定の欄は空欄です。紙が空いているから予定なしとも、私のメモがあるから検査ありとも決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 案内空欄とメモ存在で予定を断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here it is. The schedule section is blank. I can't conclude there is no appointment because the paper is blank, or that there is a test because I have that note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not draw conclusions about the schedule from the blank information sheet or the existence of your note. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 診療担当から確認のご案内をします。こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The clinical staff will explain the confirmed information. Please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 待ちます。家族には、説明を確認中なので、来週の予定はまだ知らせられないとだけ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 待機し家族へ確認中だけ連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait. I'll just tell my family that I'm checking the explanation and cannot tell them next week's schedule yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Wait and tell your family only that confirmation is in progress. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ、来週という言葉がどの用件か確認したいとお伝えしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've told the person in charge that you want to check what 'next week' refers to.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。返事を聞いたら、日時だけでなく用件も一緒にメモし、家族には確認できた内容を送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 回答後は日時用件を併記して家族へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Once I hear the answer, I'll write down what it is for as well as the date and time, and send my family the information I have confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After receiving the answer, note both the date and time and the purpose, then tell your family. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当のご案内をお待ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait for the staff member's guidance. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 交通教室で、どんなことを確認したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to check in the traffic safety class?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日本では自転車に乗り始めたばかりです。母国で長く乗った経験はありますが、こちらの交差点の見方を一緒に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 母国乗車経験と日本の交差点確認希望を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've only just started cycling in Japan. I have years of cycling experience in my home country, but I'd like to go over how to assess intersections here together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your cycling experience in your home country and your wish to check intersections in Japan. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 教室では案内の教材を使います。実際の交差点へすぐ乗り出す練習ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We use the instructional materials provided in the class. It is not a practice session where you immediately ride out into actual intersections.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まず教材で学びます。乗れるから何でも分かる、と答えるより、日本でまだ迷う所を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 教材から学び乗車可能を全理解としない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll learn from the materials first. Rather than saying I understand everything because I can ride, I'll explain the things that still confuse me in Japan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Learn from the materials first and do not equate being able to ride with understanding everything. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どのような時に迷いましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: In what situations were you unsure?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 歩行者と自転車の進む位置が別々に示されている所です。記憶だけで正しい進み方を私が教えることはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 歩行者自転車の位置表示で迷う事実を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: At places where the paths for pedestrians and bicycles are indicated separately. I can't teach others the correct way to proceed based on my memory alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you were confused by the signs indicating positions for pedestrians and bicycles. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その疑問を担当へ伝えます。参加はご本人だけでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll pass that question on to the instructor. Will you be the only person participating?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今回は私一人です。家族にも後で話したいですが、教室で確認した範囲だけにして、知らない道路の答えまで広げません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 単独参加と家族へ共有する学習範囲を限定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: This time it will just be me. I'd like to tell my family about it afterward too, but I'll stick to what I confirm in the class and won't extend it to answers about roads I don't know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you are attending alone and limit what you share with your family to what you learn. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 申込みの案内をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll give you the application information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内を受け取りました。日程を見て申し込みます。母国での経験と、こちらで質問したい内容を分けて参加します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日程申込と経験と質問の整理を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received it. I'll look at the dates and apply. When I attend, I'll distinguish my experience in my home country from the things I want to ask about here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to check the dates and apply, organizing your experience separately from your questions. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、教室でお待ちしております。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We look forward to seeing you in the class. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒が開いていたというご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're here about an envelope that was open, is that right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: そう思って来ましたが、家族に電話したら、受け取ってから家で開けたそうです。配達の時から開いていたという話ではなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族の配達後開封判明で初相談を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: That's what I thought when I came, but when I called my family, they said they opened it at home after receiving it. It is no longer a case of it having been open at delivery.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct your original inquiry after learning your family opened it after delivery. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご家族が開けたと分かった経緯を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me how you learned that your family opened it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 母が玄関で受け取り、私宛てと気付かず開けたと言っています。私は帰宅した時の封筒だけを見ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 母受領開封と本人帰宅時だけの観察を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: My mother says she received it at the front door and opened it without realizing it was addressed to me. I only saw the envelope when I got home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your mother received and opened it, and that you only observed it when you came home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 配達時の状態は、ご自身では見ていないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: So you did not see its condition at the time of delivery yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。母は配達時には閉じていたと言っています。私が目で見たことと、母から今聞いたことを分けてお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 直接目撃と母の説明を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: That's right. My mother says it was closed when delivered. I'll distinguish what I saw myself from what I've just heard from her.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish your direct observations from your mother's explanation. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内容物について、足りない物があるとのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are you reporting that something is missing from the contents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 中身は差出人の案内と一致しました。不足を申し出たいのではなく、最初の「配達時に開封済み」という説明を訂正したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 内容一致で不足なしと訂正目的を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The contents matched the sender's description. I don't want to report missing items; I want to correct my initial explanation that it was 'already open at delivery.'
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that the contents match, nothing is missing, and your purpose is to correct your account. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 訂正した内容を確認しました。今後は家族間でも宛名を確認していただくとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've confirmed your correction. It would be good for your family to check the addressee in future too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 母へ自分宛ては開けず渡してほしいと伝えます。今回の封筒は持ち帰り、郵便局へ配達事故の対応を頼むことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家庭で宛名確認を頼み郵便事故要求をやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask my mother to give me mail addressed to me without opening it. I'll take this envelope home and won't ask the post office to handle it as a delivery incident.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask your family to check addressees and withdraw the request to treat it as a postal delivery incident. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、お知らせありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for letting us know. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お子様と、銀行の仕事の案内をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you and your child looking for information about bank work?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。子どもが銀行の仕事をいろいろ聞きたがっています。私の手続きの途中で毎回質問するより、別に学べる案内があるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子の仕事質問と本人手続きを別に案内希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My child wants to ask all sorts of questions about work at a bank. Rather than asking questions each time during my transactions, I'd like to know whether there is information they can learn from separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request separate information for your child's questions about bank work and for your own transactions. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 個別の窓口で見学の質問に長く対応することはできません。公開の案内があるか確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot spend a long time answering observational visit questions at individual counters. We can check whether public information is available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうしてください。隣の人の取引を見て教えてもらうのでなく、公開の説明だけを子どもと読みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 他客取引を見ず公開説明のみ求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. I'd like to read only the public explanations with my child, rather than have someone teach us by watching the person next to us conduct a transaction.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask only for public explanations without watching other customers' transactions. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内はお持ち帰りいただけます。一般の仕事の紹介で、他のお客様の情報は出ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You may take the information home. It introduces general bank work and contains no information about other customers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。子どもには私の隣で待ってもらい、質問はノートへ書きます。係の方が他の方へ何を聞くかをのぞかせません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人手続優先で子質問をノートへ控える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, please. I'll have my child wait beside me and write the questions in a notebook. I won't let them peek at what the staff ask other people.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Prioritize your own transaction and record your child's questions in a notebook. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらが一般の銀行の仕事を紹介した案内です。個々のお客様の手続き内容は載っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is the information introducing general bank work. It does not describe individual customers' transactions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。家で読み、子どもの質問がその案内で分かるか見ます。私が知らないことは銀行員が言ったこととして教えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家庭で公開案内を読み未確認話を銀行発言としない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. We'll read it at home and see whether it answers my child's questions. I won't teach things I don't know as if a bank employee had said them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Read the public information at home and do not attribute unconfirmed explanations to bank staff. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この案内では、預金とお金を送る仕事を紹介しています。お子様と見たい部分は分かりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: This information introduces work involving deposits and sending money. Have you identified the parts you want to look at with your child?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。まず預金のページを一緒に読みます。子どもが気になった言葉をノートへ書いたので、家でゆっくり説明を見られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 預金ページから親子で読み不明語ノートと案内を持帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. We'll start by reading the deposit page together. I've written the words my child wondered about in the notebook, so we can take our time looking at the explanations at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Start with the deposit page together and take home the information and the notebook of unfamiliar words. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内をお渡ししました。どうぞお子様とお読みください。それでは、ご本人の手続きは担当窓口へご案内します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've given you the information. Please read it with your child. Now I'll direct you to the appropriate counter for your own transaction. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お買物の荷物について、何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I help you with your shopping bags?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二袋になり、一度に運ぶのが重いです。自宅が近いので、一袋を先に運び、もう一袋を取りに戻る方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 重い二袋を二回運搬するため一袋預かりを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have two bags, and they're heavy to carry at once. I live nearby, so I'd like to discuss taking one bag home first and coming back for the other.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about leaving one bag temporarily so you can carry two heavy bags in two trips. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この店では会計済みの荷物を、ご指定の短い時間だけサービス台でお預かりできます。中身は何でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: At this store, we can hold paid-for shopping at the service counter for a specified short period. What is in the bags?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一袋は洗剤と紙製品、もう一袋は冷蔵食品です。冷蔵食品を先に持ち帰り、日用品の方をお願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 冷蔵食品先と日用品預かりの内容を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: One bag contains detergent and paper products, and the other has refrigerated food. I'd like to take the refrigerated food home first and leave the household items with you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify that the refrigerated food will go first and that you wish to leave the household items. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 日用品の袋を、三十分以内のご来店でお預かりします。確認用の札をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll hold the bag of household items if you return within thirty minutes. I'll give you a claim tag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三十分以内に戻れます。取っておいてもらう日用品だけここへ出し、冷蔵食品は今運びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三十分以内戻りで日用品のみ預ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can return within thirty minutes. I'll leave only the household items you are holding here and take the refrigerated food now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Leave only the household items and say you will return within thirty minutes. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 札の番号は七です。お受取りの時に、札と袋の内容をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The tag number is seven. When collecting it, please check the tag and the contents of the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 七を持ちました。袋には洗剤一本と紙製品二つが入っています。帰りの分も自分で運ぶ予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号七と洗剤一本紙二つを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have number seven. The bag contains one bottle of detergent and two paper products. I plan to carry this load myself on the return trip too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm number seven, one bottle of detergent, and two paper products. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お預かりしました。戻られた時は、こちらのサービス台へお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We've accepted the bag for safekeeping. Please come to this service counter when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: サービス台に戻ります。短い預かりが使えるので、二回に分けて無理なく運べます。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同サービス台へ戻り二回自力運搬を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll come back to the service counter. Since short-term storage is available, I can carry everything myself in two manageable trips. Thank you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to return to the same service counter and carry the shopping yourself in two trips. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、三十分以内にお待ちしております。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll be waiting for you within thirty minutes. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 探検ゲームの受付ですね。案内を開けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're registering for the exploration game, right? Can you open the instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 電話の電池が切れて、画面を開けません。子どもと参加したいので、紙で読める問題があるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 携帯電池切れで紙問題の参加可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My phone battery is dead, so I can't open the screen. I'd like to participate with my child, so I want to know whether there are questions we can read on paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can participate using paper questions because your phone battery is dead. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ問題を載せた紙の案内もあります。回答は、用紙へ書いてこちらへお出しいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We also have a paper guide containing the same questions. You can write your answers on the sheet and submit it here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 紙の方で参加します。電話を充電するまで待つより、今の道具で子どもと読みながら進められます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紙参加へ切替え充電待ちを不要にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: We'll participate using paper. Rather than wait until the phone is charged, we can proceed now, reading together with my child using what we have.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Switch to paper participation so you do not have to wait for charging. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの四問です。地図の範囲は、この園路までになっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here are the four questions. The area shown on the map extends as far as this park path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 四問を確認しました。子どもが文字を読み、私は地図の位置を一緒に見ます。書く鉛筆は持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 四問地図範囲と親子役鉛筆持参を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've checked the four questions. My child will read the text, and I'll look at the map locations together with them. I have a pencil to write with.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the four questions and map boundary, explain your roles, and say you brought a pencil. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 戻る受付はここです。答えをそろえたら、お越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: This is the reception desk to return to. Come here when you have all the answers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 園路の四か所を回って答えを書きました。最後の答えだけ、字が読みにくいのでここで書き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 四箇所回答後に最後の字を読み易く直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: We visited the four places along the park paths and wrote the answers. Only the writing for the last answer is hard to read, so I'll rewrite it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After answering at four locations, rewrite the last answer legibly. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 四つとも読み取れました。紙でも同じ参加の記録をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I could read all four. We'll give you the same record of participation when you use paper too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 記録を受け取りました。電話が使えなくても参加できたので、紙の地図と子どもの回答を一緒に持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同等参加記録と紙回答地図を持帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received the record. We were able to participate even without using the phone, so I'll take home the paper map and my child's answers together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take home the equivalent participation record, paper answers, and map. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご参加ありがとうございました。それでは、親子でよい一日を。さようなら。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for participating. Have a lovely day together. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 待合に置き忘れた上着をお探しですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking for a jacket you left in the waiting room, is that right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。列車の時刻を見に出た間に忘れました。薄い緑の上着で、左のポケットへ手袋を入れています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 緑上着と左ポケット手袋の置忘れを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I left it behind when I went out to check the train time. It's a light green jacket, and I have a glove in the left pocket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe the forgotten green jacket and the glove in its left pocket. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらで一着お預かりしています。座っていた場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have one jacket here. Please tell me where you were sitting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口から二番目の椅子です。背もたれへ掛け、私は十分ほど前に外へ出ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二番椅子背と十分前退出を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The second chair from the entrance. I hung it over the backrest and went outside about ten minutes ago.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Mention the back of the second chair and that you went out ten minutes ago. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 色と場所が合っています。ポケットの特徴も、ご本人と確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The color and location match. We'll also confirm the pocket details with you as its owner.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 右には何も入れず、左に黒い手袋が片方あります。手袋には内側に白い糸の縫い目があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 空右と片手袋の白縫目で照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is nothing in the right pocket, and a single black glove in the left. The glove has stitching in white thread on the inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify it by the empty right pocket and the single glove's white stitching. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その特徴が確認できました。受取りの記録をお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We've confirmed those details. Could you fill in the collection record?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、案内を見て記入します。上着が見つかったので、予定の列車に乗る前に受け取って着ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 記録記入後乗車前に受領着用を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I'll read the instructions and fill it in. Now that the jacket has been found, I'd like to collect it and put it on before boarding my scheduled train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Fill in the record and ask to collect and wear it before boarding. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらがお客様の上着です。ほかの持ち物もおそろいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is your jacket. Do you have all your other belongings too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 上着と手袋を確認しました。かばんは持っています。今度は席を離れる時に上着も持って立ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 上着手袋かばんを確認し離席時持参を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked the jacket and glove. I have my bag. Next time I'll pick up my jacket too when I leave my seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the jacket, glove, and bag, and decide to take the jacket whenever you leave your seat. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お渡しできてよかったです。それでは、お気をつけてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'm glad we could return it to you. Take care and have a safe train journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 講座の修了証のお名前を確認しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: We're checking the name on your course completion certificate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私の姓の読みが「はやし」ではなく「りん」です。漢字は同じなので、読みも載るなら確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同漢字異読の本人姓読みを証書前に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My surname is pronounced 'Rin,' not 'Hayashi.' The kanji is the same, so if the reading is included too, please check it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check your surname's different reading despite the same kanji before the certificate is issued. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この修了証は漢字の氏名だけを載せます。受付の読みは訂正できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This certificate includes only your name in kanji. We can correct the reading in the reception records.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 証書へふりがなを足す依頼ではなく、呼ばれる時の読みを直したいです。漢字の二文字はこのままで大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 証書ふりがな追加でなく受付読み訂正を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm not asking you to add furigana to the certificate; I want to correct how my name is read when I'm called. The two kanji characters can stay as they are.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request a correction to the reception reading rather than the addition of furigana to the certificate. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付の読みをリンへ直しました。ご本人用の証書をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've corrected the reading at reception to Rin. I'll give you your certificate now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受け取りました。名前と講座名を見ます。講座の日時も、私が参加した回のものになっていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 証書氏名講座日時を本人参加回と照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've received it. I'll check the name and course title. The course date and time also match the session I attended, don't they?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Compare the certificate's name, course, date, and time with the session you attended. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。内容をご確認いただけましたら、受取欄へお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Once you have checked the details, please fill in the receipt section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この欄へ名前を書きます。二回参加しましたが、今回お渡しの一枚についての受取ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受取欄署名の対象が今回一枚か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll write my name in this section. I attended twice, but this receipt is for the one certificate being handed to me now, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check that your signature in the receipt section covers this one certificate. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今回の講座の修了証一枚です。以前の回の物は含まれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: It is one completion certificate for this course. It does not include the one for the previous session.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一枚受け取りました。前回のものと区別して、家の書類入れへ保管します。読みの確認も助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今回一枚受領と前回分別保管を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received one certificate. I'll keep it in my document folder at home separately from the previous one. Thank you for checking the pronunciation too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you received this one certificate and will store it separately from the previous one. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご修了おめでとうございます。それでは、次の講座でもお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Congratulations on completing the course. We look forward to seeing you at the next course too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内の紙をご覧いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you look at the information sheet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 普段の読む眼鏡を家に忘れました。名前や番号は分かりますが、この小さい説明は今読めません。要点を読んでもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 読用眼鏡忘れで小説明の読み上げを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left my usual reading glasses at home. I can make out the names and numbers, but I can't read this small explanation now. Could you read the main points to me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for the small explanation to be read aloud because you forgot your reading glasses. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 読み上げて確認します。まず、この案内は次回の受付についてです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll read it aloud so we can check it. First, this information concerns reception for your next visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。見えないから内容が分かったと返事をせず、聞いたことを自分のメモへ大きく書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 分かったふりをせず大字本人メモを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. Since I can't see it, I don't want to say I understand the contents without knowing them; I'd like to write what I hear in large letters in my own notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Do not pretend to understand; ask to make your own notes in large writing. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 次回は受付の開始時刻と予約時刻が別に記載されています。どちらもお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: For your next visit, the reception opening time and your appointment time are listed separately. I'll tell you both.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二つの時刻を大きい字で書きました。到着する目安は受付時刻として、家で元の紙とも比べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受付と予約時刻を別記し帰宅後紙照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've written the two times in large letters. I'll use the reception time as my target arrival time and compare my notes with the original paper at home too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Write the reception and appointment times separately and compare them with the paper after getting home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お持ちになる物も読み上げます。今お持ちの予約票は、保管しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll also read out the things to bring. Please keep the appointment slip you have now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 予約票を手帳に入れました。読み上げていただいた内容は大きい字で残せたので、家で眼鏡を使って元の紙と比べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約票保管と聴取内容の大字メモで帰宅後照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've put the appointment slip in my planner. I've recorded what you read aloud in large writing, so I'll use my glasses at home to compare it with the original sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep the appointment slip and compare your large-print notes of what you heard with the original at home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 聞き直したい所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is there any part you would like to hear again?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 持ち物の最後だけもう一度お願いします。書けましたので、その項目も家で眼鏡を使って案内と照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持物最後を再読依頼し帰宅後照合を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please repeat just the last item on the list of things to bring. I've written it down, so I'll check that item against the guide with my glasses at home too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for the last item to bring to be read again and say you will compare it at home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、案内とメモを一緒にお持ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26213-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take the information sheet and your notes together. Take care of yourself.
